annotations.title: Write the report email for the client

description: The email that sends a period's brand report to the client: to, subject, and a body with a few sentences from the numbers and the report's read-only link (made now if the period has none, working 90 days), plus a mailto: address that opens it in a mail app. Nothing is sent: send body through the person's own mail. Default: the schedule's period, last full one.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

starts_on.description: Any day in the period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the last full one

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: report_email_create
